description: Generic data hall, Project.md section 3. Origin at the building centre on the ground; x along the long axis toward the flue end; z up. All lengths in metres. Kinds: indicative values from the brief are labelled; they are replaced by datasheet values when cited.

parapet.model: zero-thickness baffle on the roof perimeter

chillers.model: solid boxes; intake on the two long side faces (normal to x) as fixed-flow sinks; discharge through a top strip whose area = flow / discharge speed so mass flow and momentum flux are both right

flues.model: vertical cylinders; fixed-flow exit; isothermal in the MVP with the momentum ratio matched; tip height is the design variable D0 3 m, D1 6 m, D2 9 m

intake.louvre_faces: the two side faces normal to y
intake.kind: brief; intake flow to be set and cited
intake.model: solid box; each louvre a fixed-flow sink
